entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: An angelic warrior who made ruin real whenever Ixidor imagined it.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: A creator who had only to imagine his enemies' ruin for Akroma to enact it.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The tyrant of Mirrodin, to whose will even clouds bend, who threatens to erase memory of those he kills.

entities.name: Brudiclad
entities.description: A Telchor engineer who finds the sounds of a sarcomite myr almost musical.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A man whose soul was snared by an angel's curse, who twisted heroism into shadow and became an ascendant evincar.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A tyrant who craves power without limit.

entities.name: Radavi
entities.description: A Joraga relic hunter who speaks defiant last words.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: A figure who drinks her victims' energy, losing the memory of her past self Jeska.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A warrior adept whose memory stirs in Phage.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior of the Weatherlight who is tired of being told to relax by a fire.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight who sent the *Predator* crashing into Crovax's stronghold.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Sisay's ship with a mirrored hull usable as a defensive weapon.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Skyship crashed into Crovax's stronghold; Vhati looked from it at Greven's thunderhead.

entities.name: Matoc
entities.description: A lavamancer who muses about goblins wanting to be on the winning side.

entities.name: Vhati
entities.description: A figure who gazes at a thunderhead from the Predator.

entities.name: Greven
entities.description: A captain of Rath whose mind Vhati sees in a thunderhead.

entities.name: Sheyda
entities.description: An Ondu gamekeeper who wants to tame more than hurdas and oxen.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A former pit fighter who left a violent life but still believes in muscle.

entities.name: Rakka Mar
entities.description: A Jund leader who says lightning lives in everything.

entities.name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
entities.description: A Jund warrior who says any sword will do.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A Boros Legion member who reveres the weight of a Boros signet.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: An elf who searches for the truth about Memnarch.

entities.name: Bosh, Iron Golem
entities.description: An iron golem who searches for secrets of his past.

entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: An elder researcher who wonders at the Darksteel Forge's shape.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: Destined leader of the leonin prides, throne at Taj-Nar.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A warlord and commander of countless nim, denned at Ish Sah.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane whose origin secret is kept by Tel-Jilad's trolls.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A hydra-god believed to sleep beneath Naya.

entities.name: The Mirari
entities.description: An artifact in the Cabal's vault whose darkness radiated across Otaria.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: An order whose fighters fear what follows death.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose swiftblades enter the fray first and whose mage-priests are respected by the innocent.

entities.name: Razia, Boros Archangel
entities.description: An archangel of the Boros whose sword burns brightly.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Metal creatures of Mirrodin who observe other species on behalf of their creator.

entities.name: Raksha
entities.description: A leonin stronghold, throne of Raksha.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: Wellspring of molten metal and temple of the goblin horde.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: Site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

entities.name: Tel-Jilad
entities.description: Sanctum of the ancient trolls, keepers of the secret of Mirrodin's origin.

entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: Den of the warlord Geth.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: The Boros fortress, seat of justice.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Land across which the Mirari's darkness radiated.

events.summary: Ixidor imagines his enemies' ruin and Akroma makes it so.
events.quote: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

events.summary: Memnarch's will bends even the clouds to swallow his opponents.
events.quote: Even the clouds bend themselves to Memnarch's will, eager to swallow those who oppose him.

events.summary: Crovax, snared by an angel's curse, twists heroism into shadow and becomes an ascendant evincar.
events.quote: His soul snared by an angel's curse, Crovax twisted heroism into its purest shadow.

events.summary: Volrath states he has not discovered too much power.
events.quote: If there is such a thing as too much power, I have not discovered it.

events.summary: Crovax declares bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave.
events.quote: The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave.

events.summary: Radavi speaks last words defying dark curses.
events.quote: A little dark magic won't stop me.

events.summary: As Phage drinks her victims' energy, a faint memory of Jeska stirs, then is lost in joy of their suffering.
events.quote: As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred.

events.summary: Mirri warns that the next person to tell her to relax by a fire is dead.
events.quote: The next one who tells me to relax and curl up by a fire is dead.

events.summary: Matoc muses that goblins wanted to be on the winning side for once.
events.quote: Maybe they wanted to be on the winning side for once.

events.summary: Vhati gazes up at a thunderhead from the Predator and sees Greven's mind.
Sheyda complains that more than hurdas and oxen could be tamed.
events.quote: Surely we could tame something besides hurdas and pillarfield oxen!

events.summary: Sisay discovers the Weatherlight's mirrored hull can be used defensively.
events.quote: Sisay discovered that the mirrored hull of the *Weatherlight* could be used as a defensive weapon.

events.summary: Sisay sends the Predator crashing into Crovax's stronghold, alerting him they are coming.
events.quote: I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold.

events.summary: Agrus Kos describes the weight of strength and pride in a Boros signet.
events.quote: Have you ever held a Boros signet?

events.summary: Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch while Bosh searches for his past.
events.quote: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

events.summary: Memnarch threatens that all memory of a victim's existence will be wiped from reality.
events.quote: All memory of your existence will be wiped from reality.

events.summary: As the fifth sun joins the other four, new abilities awaken in creatures of Mirrodin.
events.quote: As the fifth sun joins the other four, new abilities awaken in the creatures of Mirrodin.

events.summary: The Mirari pulses in the Cabal's vault, its darkness radiating across Otaria.
events.quote: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun

relations.note: Akroma carries out ruin that Ixidor imagines.
relations.quote: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

relations.note: She searches for the truth about Memnarch.
relations.quote: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch
